<thought>Based on the dominant m/z 141.115 peak (likely [M+H]+), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈140.108 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1) indicates about eight carbons. A formula with 8 carbons that fits the mass closely is C₈H₁₂O₂ (exact mass 140.0837 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C8H12O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
